terra.problem: The farming joke doesn't hold: a farmer who sowed less would welcome the same-size harvest.
Paul tells people not to give under compulsion or with regret. Saying nobody gets pushed or gives with a sigh presents that instruction as a fact about everyone.
Saying God loves a cheerful giver, not a grumbling or counting-every-crumb giver, suggests God does not love those other givers. Paul doesn't say that.
